headline: Xinhua Economic Essay: What the National Day Travel Boom Reveals About China's Consumer Vitality
summary: China recorded 826 million domestic trips over the seven-day 2026 National Day holiday, with domestic travel spending of RMB 738.375 billion. Figures rose 6.3% and 4.3% year on year on a comparable basis.
why: Holiday travel and spending data are a timely indicator of household consumption, which is a key driver of China's economic growth.
